summary: Build ISO 31000 and COSO ERM skills to align risk with strategy, monitor execution, and report clearly. Enrol in practical training.
lede: Enterprise risk management training helps risk, strategy, audit, and business leaders connect risk decisions with strategic objectives and execution. Participants practise mapping and assessing risks, aligning appetite and response plans with objectives, and monitoring delivery through integrated KPI and KRI reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who connect enterprise risk management with strategic planning, governance, assurance, and execution oversight. It suits intermediate practitioners who already work with business objectives, performance information, risk records, or internal controls and need a more integrated operating approach.
modules: Digital Risk Sensing and Data Governance
prerequisites: Working knowledge of organizational objectives, strategic planning, operational risk, internal controls, or performance reporting is expected. No programming is required. Familiarity with risk registers or executive reporting will help you apply the exercises more quickly.
